announced on Wednesday that it plans to offer
notes due 2033, with an option for initial buyers to purchase up to an additional $150M.
The senior, unsecured notes will mature on October 1, 2033, with the interest rate and initial conversion terms to be set at pricing.
The company plans to use part of the proceeds for capped call transactions and to repurchase some of its outstanding 2027 and 2028 convertible notes.
The remaining proceeds will support general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures, potential acquisitions, and strategic transactions.
The company expects the capped calls to limit potential stock dilution from the new convertible notes, although dilution could still occur if the stock price rises above the capped-call price.

title: Halozyme Therapeutics plans a $1.05B convertible notes sale
